name: Orgain Clean Protein Grass Fed RTD Shake (Creamy Chocolate)
whyItWorks: Provides 20g of clean milk protein isolate that has been ultra-filtered to remove lactose, with only 1g of fiber and 3g sugar. Avoids the heavy prebiotic plant gums found in their standard plant shake.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill and drink straight from carton. Great quick protein source between meals.
